t: This Spectrum Drinking Water Filter Cartridge is a 10" carbon block designed to significantly improve water quality. It effectively reduces chlorine, unpleasant tastes, and odours, delivering cleaner, fresher drinking water at the point of use. Ideal for kitchens, offices, or site welfare units, this standard 10" water filter cartridge fits common housings. Its easy installation and replacement ensure consistent water quality for various under-sink and tap water filter applications.
